title.narrative: Savannah and Sahel Commodities Limited and University of York

description.narrative: The AAKTP will allow SSCL to develop recipes & processes to make fortified blended flours (FBFs) from a variety of ingredients, to prepare nutritious & healthy daily meals for over 150k households & 200k needy Ghanaian school children, improving food security, nutrition, health & wellbeing. This AAKTP aligns well with SSCL’s vision to improve nutrition & food security in Ghana & West Africa. Our goal is to seize opportunities of recent reports of poor quality food of Ghana’s School Feeding Programme (Peter Goldsmith et al., 2019 (see Appendix 1)) through this AAKTP in order to supply nutritious, high quality & safe food to improve the health & wellbeing of children from poor households. The strategy of SSCL is to leverage financial & technical support provided by this AAKTP to integrate & fast-track innovative downstream value chains into local agrifood systems in Ghana. The founder of SSCL is an innovative leader, and majority shareholder of SekaF, producers of TAMA products (https://www.tamacosmetics.com/index.html). He has a track record of turning local raw material to internationally accepted cosmetics brands that are listed on the EU Cosmetics Portal. SSCL was formed to occupy a niche in the food processing sector in Northern Ghana & Savanna Belt of West Africa with unacceptably high levels of malnutrition due to poor quality food. SSCL plans to leverage the placement of the Associate to produce well branded & packaged nutritious food for both local & international markets. SSCL spent the first 3 years of its growth plan to build a solid foundation for the supply of high-quality cereals & oilseeds for its future agri-processing business. It now aims to move into high-value, nutritious food processing to alleviate hunger. SSCL’s immediate objectives are: Optimise Fortified Blended Flour (FBF) supply chains in Ghana markets within 2 years, Improve nutritional content of flour used for school meals through formulation and blending of maize, sorghum, soy & sheabutter, Analyse the biochemistry & nutrition of the new, FBF in UDS laboratories to optimise quality & safety, Set up pilot Food Processing Facility to produce new, fortified brands for local markets, Carry out nutrition & feeding trials to improve quality and safety
